name: True World-Space MPR Sampling
definition: Samples a 3D volume to generate a 2D MPR image by iterating over pixel grid coordinates, converting to world space, transforming to voxel space, and interpolating the volume value.
summary: True World-Space MPR Sampling extracts arbitrary volume slices by defining the sampling plane via world-space vectors, ensuring geometric accuracy relative to the patient coordinate system rather than voxel grid axes.
